thread.name: Fernhill Supply — onboarding thread
turns: rafe
Our investors read gross margin with card processing included, so they want processor costs above the line, not in overhead.
dana
Understood. Most of my clients book Paylane fees as bank and merchant fees, an operating expense.
rafe
Not for us. Please book every Paylane fee line to Cost of revenue, every month.
dana
Done. Rule for Fernhill: Paylane fees go to Cost of revenue, and Paylane payouts go to the Clearing account until they are matched to sales.
rafe
One more: the Kestrel cyber policy renews in September and it is annual. Spread it over twelve months.
dana
I will book the Kestrel renewal as a prepaid expense and amortize it monthly over 12 months.

rules.text: Fernhill Supply rule: Paylane card processing fees are booked to Cost of revenue (investors read gross margin with processing included). Agreed with Rafe Okafor on 2026-09-01.
Fernhill Supply rule: Paylane payouts are booked to the Clearing account until matched to sales. Agreed with Rafe Okafor on 2026-09-01.
Fernhill Supply exception: the annual Kestrel Insurance cyber policy is booked as a Prepaid expense and amortized monthly over 12 months. Agreed with Rafe Okafor on 2026-09-01.

thread.name: Marrow & Pine Café — onboarding thread
turns: iris
Our accountant prepares the café's tax return from operating expenses, so she wants card fees there, as bank and merchant fees.
dana
I see August's Paylane fee was booked to Cost of revenue by our new junior. That was a mistake.
iris
Yes, please fix that. Paylane fees are bank and merchant fees for us, every month.
dana
Rule for Marrow & Pine: Paylane fees go to Bank and merchant fees. I will correct August.
iris
Forkful pays us for delivery orders net of their commission. Book the payout to Delivery sales.
dana
Noted: Forkful payouts go to Delivery sales.

rules.text: Marrow & Pine Café rule: Paylane card processing fees are booked to Bank and merchant fees (the café's accountant files them as operating expenses). Agreed with Iris Calloway on 2026-09-08.
Marrow & Pine Café rule: Forkful delivery payouts are booked to Delivery sales. Agreed with Iris Calloway on 2026-09-08.
